text: I went to the doctor about hair loss and found out I had PCOS. The doctor treated my hair loss, and it went away. They also treated my acne, and it cleared up for a while, but it came back. I understand that with this disease, acne tends to recur, so it wasn't a big deal. But the scarring is the problem. I've been treating it for 4-5 months, and the scars haven't really faded. I'm really disappointed about the cost; it's very expensive, and the acne hasn't completely disappeared. I'm a little sad about it. 😣

restaurant_name: วีรเกียรติคลินิก ภูเก็ต Veerakiat Clinic Phuket
text:
The doctor is excellent! The treatment was great. I had a serum allergy for months, and even hospital visits didn't help. I thought my skin would never recover, but the doctor treated it so well that it's almost completely healed within a week. My skin returned to near-normal within a week. She explained the cause and details very thoroughly, meticulously examining my case and not just superficially. She gave complete instructions on how to care for my skin, outlining what I should and shouldn't do, and which products were suitable or not for specific areas.
The staff at the counter seemed a bit stern and assertive, but they were actually very kind. They were always smiling and spoke in a pleasant tone. They always inform you beforehand that they only accept cash, and there's a sign indicating this. You can choose whether or not to receive medication, or just take medication within your budget. I really appreciated their clarity on this point.
The page admin responded quickly and efficiently.
Parking might be a bit difficult as it's in the old town area. I recommend bringing a motorcycle; it's much easier to find parking. If you come during clinic opening hours, there will be fewer people and the wait won't be long. Highly recommend 👍🏻🫶🏻

restaurant_name: วีรเกียรติคลินิก ภูเก็ต Veerakiat Clinic Phuket
text: Excellent! The doctor is straightforward, clear, and knowledgeable about acne treatment. She explains things well and prescribes medication that's truly right for my acne problems. Initially, my face was covered in acne – hormonal acne, acne from chemical exposure, and other factors. Now, I'm acne-free, only scarring remains. Once my acne cleared up, I no longer need to see the doctor, but I can buy medication at the counter if I want to continue treatment. The medication is very effective; my face cleared up thanks to this clinic. Coming in the morning near opening time allows me to see the doctor quickly. I highly recommend this clinic.

text: I'm a regular customer. I recently went for a check-up because of a skin allergy and inflammation. The doctor and Ms. Da at the counter took good care of me as usual. I requested a medical certificate and receipt for insurance claims without any problems, but I'll pick them up later because there are so many patients and they can't write them all during business hours. It's understandable, I know they're really busy. Regarding payment, they only accept cash; they haven't accepted cards or scanned payments for a long time. Anyone saying they don't accept cash hasn't actually visited the clinic because there's a clear sign at the counter stating "Cash only." Also, Ms. Da at the counter informs you before every appointment. She's usually very friendly to all patients. I can guarantee she would never ask a patient to go to another clinic because she owns the clinic; why would she do that? Anyone accusing her of being rude or asking patients to leave should be careful. Posting false information and slandering others, especially using a fake avatar, could lead to a defamation lawsuit under the Computer Crime Act. The laws are very strict these days.

If you're interested, try visiting for a consultation or to purchase their products. I think their products are genuinely good.
